Display Jungle Pocket (Summer Gym Clothes), running in high spirits

"From the inside, Fuji Kiseki! Fuji Kiseki on the inside!
She's surging ahead along the rail!"

—Wait!!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, this is Fuji-san, ain't it?!?!

Right, right, exactly!! That's what makes Fuji-san so damn awesome!
Haha, you—

The race in this video proves it too. Her dominance went far beyond the winning margin...
She read the movements of the late-charging Umamusume perfectly and shut them down!

Huh? Have we met before?
More importantly, teach me that ultimate killer move of yours!
—Hm? What's up, Trainer?

In a recent intra-academy race, she won by a crushing three-and-a-half lengths.
She possesses tremendous talent, capable of adapting to any track condition and any race pace.
—I'm running in this too!

Hell yeah, of course!!
Fuji-san is the real deal!

Hell yeah, cleared it!! You've gotten pretty good, haven't ya?!
Haha, man, you sucked so bad at first!

Lately, I've been hanging out with them almost every day. As a Trainer,
I couldn't help but wonder if this was really okay. But—

She wasn't just strong, she didn't just win.
She put on a crazy performance that blew everyone away!

However, that advice was tailored to that girl's running style.
The triple-scoop ice cream girl should have a weapon of her own.
This!! This is the one I wanna take down!

The sheer power of her stride should hold up on any track condition,
and she seems to have plenty of stamina, meaning she can maintain a strong late kick over a long stretch.

I'm starvin'~ Family restaurant first, for sure.
Oh, heard they got darts at the net cafe by the station, let's hit it up!

What we were discussing earlier was instantaneous burst. Legs that can sharply
accelerate right when needed are a crucial factor in races—a real weapon.
What is that... A monster...?
...Man, she's SO FREAKIN' COOL!!!!

Wait, ah, so you can't tell without seeing me run, huh?
Well, let's go for a spin then!

'Sup.
Nice meetin' ya!

Before I knew it, Jungle Pocket and I were sharing a firm handshake.
And ever since then...

You guys better come watch if you're free.
I'm gonna crush that monster and show everyone what "the strongest" looks like.

My weapon... My weapon, huh...
Haha, now that sounds even more fun! Hey, figure one out for me too!

Nnngh—!
Whoa, Pokke-san, you're seriously insane...!

—I had been fully certified as one of her "homies."
And today, just like every other day, I was about to be dragged along for some fun.
The name of the runner she pointed to on the racecard was—

There are plenty of ways to capitalize on her strengths!
I opened my laptop to check some coaching reference materials, and—

Gaaah~~ Not again, Pokke-san!
Your instincts are unreal...!
ORA ORA ORA ORAAA!!
—Jungle Pocket!!

"The strongest"—man, I love the sound of that!
I mean, if you're gonna run, you gotta aim for the top, right?!

Found ya! You headin' home already?
Let's go hang out!

Looking for a chance to scout her, but unable to find the right moment,
one day—

Ora ora ora oraaaa!!
Take out the enemy on the right for me!!

—Doubt!!
Hehehe~~ Knew it!

These guys are my homies. We basically just hang out whenever, so
you're free to chill here anytime too.

Speaking of Agnes Tachyon... Despite not having debuted yet,
she was an unbelievable Umamusume already expected to win GⅠ races.

ALRIGHTTTT!!
I'm blowin' past every single one of 'emmm!!

Well, how's that!?
You come up with anything!?
See, you totally get it!!
—A monster? Bring it on.

I was thoroughly captivated by her running. She had the potential,
she adored Fuji Kiseki... If I could conquer the Derby together with her—

While spending time with Jungle Pocket and the others at their hangout,
an email arrived on my laptop. The content—an entry list for a mock race.
